title: docs: say Composio's GitHub tools can commit
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Updated the Composio MCP catalog, registry description, Connected apps text, agent-building guide, MCP guide, and polli skill guide to explain that connected GitHub accounts support commits as well as reading. The guides show agents committing multiple files to a caller’s fork with `GITHUB_COMMIT_MULTIPLE_FILES`; setting `base_branch` can create a new branch. Code agents can call `mcp("composio", …)` directly. The Computer shell’s `git` cannot use a caller’s Composio connection; its documented push access is to collective memory. The agent guide also corrects the connection location to Account → Connected apps.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps place a glowing commit onto a branching code-plant beside a retro computer showing a connected GitHub account. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
